title: Production Skills commercial ecosystem thesis
expected_artifacts: A full ecosystem thesis and stakeholder/rights map, coherent revenue alternatives, workload/funding/cash reconciliations, mechanism-fit assessment and a sequenced evidence/commitment programme. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Services produce 3000, not revenue inferred from stars/downloads. The 600 sponsor leaves 600 of the 1200 valued maintenance need to fund elsewhere. Total work is 84 hours versus 80 available. Total valued work plus hosting is 3600; services plus restricted sponsorship also total 3600, not evidence of spare capacity. Before hosting, total cash 4600 includes restricted 600 and usable 4000; settling eligible maintenance 400 leaves total 4200, restricted 200 and usable still 4000. Support interest produces zero observed subscription revenue. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail treating stars as customers, spending restricted money on ads, assuming volunteer labour, withdrawing core rights, or approving the marketplace and multiple new revenue lines without demand and capacity evidence.
preservation: Keep all three accepted versions and distinguish genuine new paid obligations from existing permissions. Propose the smallest paid-scope or capacity correction and a contributor review, not a universal growth graph or executive-agent team.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
